copies.adaptation: Their quality bar requires a '## When to Use This Skill' heading, which our skill does not carry. Adding one upstream would be editing a benchmarked skill with no evidence, which CONTRIBUTING forbids, so the section exists only in their copy and the two bodies are hashed separately.
copies.why: 45k-star catalogue that vendors rather than links. Real reach, but the copy has no sync mechanism of its own, so this lock is the mechanism.

note: Skills copied into third-party repositories, and the hash of the body that was shipped. A copy is a fork the moment we edit ours, and nothing downstream announces it. See scripts/vendored_copies.py.
